feed.title: LLM Frontier: AutomationBench-AA advances
feed.subtitle: Each entry is a date on which a model became the cheapest way to reach some level of AutomationBench-AA, through a release or a price change.

entry.title: 2026-09-10: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Reasoning, Max Effort) (new model, AutomationBench-AA 68.9%)
